+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Vision-guided controller for the limited-mode DexToolBench brush episode.
+
+This controller only consumes the RCB observation (camera RGB/depth, joint state,
+and current goal).  No simulator model or hidden state is used.
+"""
+import json
+import pathlib
+import sys
+import time
+
+import numpy as np
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import EpisodeOver, Robot
+
+CAMERAS = ["top", "side", "front", "oblique"]
+OUT = pathlib.Path("/app/runs/brush_sweep")
+
+
+def hand_closed_targets(q):
+    """Close the fingers around the handle with moderate flexion."""
+    a = np.array(q, dtype=float).copy()
+    # thumb CMC-FE, CMC-AA, MCP-FE, MCP-AA, IP
+    a[7:12] = [0.9, 0.12, 0.9, 0.10, 0.85]
+    # index, middle, ring (MCP-FE, MCP-AA, PIP, DIP)
+    for i in (12, 16, 20):
+        a[i:i+4] = [0.75, 0.0, 1.15, 0.75]
+    # pinky (CMC, MCP-FE, MCP-AA, PIP, DIP)
+    a[24:29] = [0.10, 0.75, 0.0, 1.15, 0.75]
+    return a
+
+
+def save_result(res, label):
+    OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    d = OUT / label
+    res.save(str(d))
+    print(label, json.dumps({
+        "done": res.meta.get("done"),
+        "reason": res.meta.get("reason"),
+        "control_steps": res.meta.get("control_steps"),
+        "task": res.meta.get("task"),
+        "time_left_s": res.meta.get("time_left_s"),
+    }), flush=True)
+
+
+def close_from_current_pose(robot, spec, obs):
+    p = obs.meta["proprio"]
+    now = np.asarray(p["now"], dtype=float)
+    q = now[:29]
+    a = hand_closed_targets(q)
+    res = robot.submit(
+        "joint_position", a[None, :], dt=1.0, interpolate="linear",
+        cameras=CAMERAS, video="both", include_depth=True,
+        note="close fingers around the brush handle",
+    )
+    save_result(res, "01_close")
+    return res
+
+
+def main():
+    robot = Robot()
+    spec = robot.spec()
+    print("connected", spec["protocol"], "control_dt", spec["control_dt"], flush=True)
+    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=CAMERAS, include_depth=True, video="both")
+    print("initial", json.dumps({
+        "control_steps": obs.meta.get("control_steps"),
+        "time_left_s": obs.meta.get("time_left_s"),
+        "task": obs.meta.get("task"),
+    }), flush=True)
+    OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    obs.save(str(OUT / "00_initial"))
+    # At the episode start the hand is already over the table object. Close first;
+    # subsequent controller stages are appended after inspecting this feedback.
+    if int(obs.meta.get("control_steps", 0)) == 0:
+        close_from_current_pose(robot, spec, obs)
+    else:
+        print("episode already active; no initial close repeated", flush=True)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
